summary: Jeep XJ attempted to ascend Red Cone the wrong way from the Webster Pass saddle; rear driveshaft failed on a 30-35-degree slope, leaving the vehicle with virtually no traction; occupants extracted by Park and Summit County SAR the night prior; 4x4 Rescue & Recovery team recovered the vehicle the next day.
responding_agency: Park County SAR; Summit County SAR
notes: Date approx: 4x4 recovery report is dated 2022-07-11 (posted 2022-07-12); SAR extraction occurred the night prior, i.e. 2022-07-10. Occupant count unstated in report (plural 'occupants'); victims=1 + note. Run 66 4x4-R&R chunk: this was the only report on the archive pages with SAR-agency involvement; the other 2022 mechanical recoveries (Miller Rock Hummer, Miners Gulch Bronco/4Runner, Mt Antero Grand Cherokee, Slaughterhouse Gulch Humvee, Nederland belaying, T-33 4Runner repair, Flopped XJ Caribou, Rampart Range F250) were 4x4-group-only vehicle recoveries with no SAR response and were excluded.
